messages:
Carly: Morning team — quick shift pass. Queue at ~28 tickets (↑6 from overnight). Two P1s: #5987 webhook 500s (ingest), #5989 embeddings stuck. I'll grab the webhook one first, leaving notes here so second shift can pick up embed work. @Devon @Mike :wave:

Devon: On it — I'll start digging into the webhook 500s. Any recent deploys?

Mike: Not from infra side since 0200 UTC. I saw a few transient 502s from azure-eu last night. Will check load balancer and recent autoscale events. :mag:

ticket-bot: New ticket created: #5987 "ingest-webhook: 500 on POST /v1/ingest" — priority: P1 — reporter: analytics-team

Carly: Thanks — payload size looks normal in sample. Suspect routing flake or a model shard timeout. If we can't rule infra quick, fall back to dedupe route: `route: ingest-fallback` to keep customers unblocked.

Anya: I'm mid-PR review but can take the embeddings ticket after lunch. Can someone add the embed ticket to my queue? (#5989)

Carly: @Anya added. Also updated the macro for webhook 5xx guidance — short snippet below for triage use:```Use macro: webhook-5xx-restart
1) Check LB health: `kubectl get pods -l svc=ingest -o wide`
2) Check kube events: `kubectl -n infra describe pod <pod>`
3) If replica count low, scale: `kubectl scale deploy ingest --replicas=3`
4) If still 5xx, route to `ingest-fallback` and escalate to oncall
```

Devon: Quick test — ran a curl with sample payload, saw 500 with stack trace pointing to `kafka-proxy` timeout. Pinging infra and @oncall-bot for escalation.

oncall-bot: Pager duty alert created for oncall@redwood — incident sprint: "kafka-proxy timeout causing ingest 500s". Join incident channel: #incident-5987

Mike: If kafka-proxy is the culprit, we should consider temporary increase to connection pool. Will prepare a small change and post rollback notes.

Carly: Great. Action items: Devon -> confirm root cause & post minimal mitigation steps; Mike -> prepare pool bump PR and add rollback; Anya -> handle #5989 after 12:30 UTC; Carly -> update customers via status page once fallback engaged. If anyone picks up other tickets, pls drop a short "taking #" message here. :thumbsup:

Devon: Taking #5987 — will update in thread as I go. :eyes:

Carly: Thanks — leaving detailed handoff in case second shift needs it: logs pinned in #incident-5987, macro used is `webhook-5xx-restart`, and fallback route ready."
